source: Yahoo public chart 5m 60d; historical revised indicative OHLCV, not executable quotes
beta: 20 prior session opening returns, minimum 10, clipped [0,3]; default 1
selection: choose validation mean daily net at base cost, minimum 5 active days, cash if nonpositive; freeze before holdout
adaptive: weekly refit using only strictly prior resolved days; pooled or regime-specific daily net, shrunk mean minus one standard error; minimum 10 active daily clusters; no-trade if nonpositive
plan_gate: at least 20 prior active days; positive mean minus 1.96 SE after stress cost; historical remains research-only
independence: all comparisons descriptive; no retuning on final test; 18 configurations and 12 simple controls disclosed; prior published sample not independent
options: no historical bid/ask chains available; scenario math only; no synthetic profitability
data_eligibility: Exclude any QQQ/IWM/SPY dividend or split session; no point-in-time action reference. Corrected after metadata inspection, not parameter retuning.
timing_contract: Prediction horizon includes 5-minute delay + holding minutes. Entry and exit at later bar opens.
